finding.title: Guard stage_definition/settings/goal merges against missing local track before FK-constrained insert
finding.rule: Nygard (I/O ordering race) — FK integrity on merge; matches the fix already applied to bookmark/gamification_settings/study_day_config
finding.why: lib/core/database/tables/stage_definitions.dart and goals.dart both declare `trackId => integer().references(CurriculumTracks, #id)()` — a real, enforced FK. If a stage_definition/settings/goal Firestore snapshot merges before its curriculum_tracks row exists locally (independent per-collection listeners, or first-launch pull on a restored device), the raw insert throws an uncaught SqliteException(787) and aborts merging the whole page. BookmarkMerger (drift_merge_store.dart:527 `if (track == null) { ...skip... }`), GamificationSettingsMerger (gamification_settings_merger.dart:128 `if (localTrack == null) continue;`) and StudyDayConfigMerger (study_day_config_merger.dart:66 `if (trackExists == null) continue;`) already guard this exact race by skipping and relying on the next (idempotent) pull to re-merge — the pattern was never generalized to stage_definition/settings/goal, which resolve the identical remote-track-id-fallback (`localTrack?.id ?? remoteTrackId`) without ever checking the fallback actually exists.
finding.recommendation: Add the same trackExists-before-insert guard (skip, don't throw; rely on idempotent re-merge next pull) to DriftMergeStore._upsertStageDefinition, _upsertSettings, and GoalMerger.merge, mirroring StudyDayConfigMerger's existing pattern.
acceptance_criteria: Integration test: merge a stage_definition (and separately a settings, and a goal) row referencing a curriculum_id with no local curriculum_tracks row yet — assert no exception is thrown and the row is silently skipped.
Same test seeds the track afterward and re-merges the identical row — assert it now applies (idempotent recovery).
New regression tests live under test/core/sync/merge/, mirroring the FK-race coverage style already present for bookmark/study_day_config.
